title: Normalized compatible short exact coefficient systems
statement: Fix a small filtered category J, a functor F:J→Cat with precoverages P on its small categories, finite coverings, continuous cover-preserving transition functors preserving covering pullbacks, and exact inverse images on sets. Fix a cocone V whose objects and arrows are colimits, a precoverage Q whose coverings are exactly transported stage coverings, and continuous canonical functors with exact inverse images on sets. Assume additive abelian inverse images, small Ext groups, and coefficient-natural cohomology pullback maps commuting with connecting maps and having the degree-zero unit formula [lem-weil-pbc-site-cohomology-pullback]. Assume inverse-image composition isomorphisms e,eV with unit equations identifying each composite adjunction unit with the successive units evaluated at every stage object. Fix a coefficient system Fs,φ with composition cocycle, its inverse-image diagram S with the specified object and Arrow equations, a colimit K, an index i, object X_i, n≥0, and degree n+1 diagram D with the specified object and transition equations [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology], [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. Then there are normalized coefficients As,θ, a compatible projection pA:Fs→As that is an isomorphism after canonical inverse image and on each specified degree n+1 stage group, injective middle coefficients Gs,ψ, cokernels Rs,ρ, and compatible stage short exact sequences 0→As→Gs→Rs→0. The induced degree-q identity transition is the identity for every q and stage object, for Gs and Rs. There are inverse-image diagrams U,T and colimits M,L with their object and Arrow equations, and a short exact sequence 0→K.pt→M.pt→L.pt→0 whose maps commute with the canonical colimit legs and pA followed by the stage embedding, respectively the stage quotient. The precise projection, stage cocycle and colimit-leg equations are those in the Lean record. This statement constructs no cohomology boundary diagrams or ladder maps; it is in continuation form.

proof.text: Split the coefficient identity idempotents as images in the abelian sheaf categories. Composition and the unit coherence give the normalized transitions. The identities of S and D make the image projections isomorphisms after canonical inverse image and in the specified positive degree.

Transpose the normalized system through the continuous adjunctions and apply the compatible injective embedding. Transpose back and take cokernels using exact inverse image. Cancel quotient epimorphisms to prove their transition cocycle. Normalized identity actions give the cohomology identity equations.

Form the actual inverse-image diagrams and choose their colimits. Apply exact filtered colimits to their pointwise short exact sequence, transport the first term along the normalized projection isomorphism to K, and obtain the two colimit-leg equations by the universal property.
